post.summary: AddDomain registers a new sending domain.  Returns everything you need: domain info, DNS records, and next steps.  MAIL FROM (mail.yourdomain.com) is auto-configured.
post.description:
AddDomain registers a new sending domain.
 Returns everything you need: domain info, DNS records, and next steps.
 MAIL FROM (mail.yourdomain.com) is auto-configured.

post.summary: DeleteDomain removes a domain from your account.
post.description: DeleteDomain removes a domain from your account.

post.summary: GetDomain retrieves a domain with its configuration and status.  Automatically refreshes from SES if data is stale (>5 min).
post.description:
GetDomain retrieves a domain with its configuration and status.
 Automatically refreshes from SES if data is stale (>5 min).

post.summary: ListDomains retrieves all domains with their status.
post.description: ListDomains retrieves all domains with their status.

post.summary: VerifyDomain forces a fresh check of DNS records and SES status.  Rate-limited to 30s between calls. Use after configuring DNS.
post.description:
VerifyDomain forces a fresh check of DNS records and SES status.
 Rate-limited to 30s between calls. Use after configuring DNS.

post.summary: SendEmail sends an email immediately or queues it for async processing.
post.description:
Behavior:
 - async=false + no attachments: Send synchronously, return message_id
 - async=true OR has attachments: Queue for processing with retries

 Delivery status is sent to your webhook endpoint.

connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version
connect-protocol-version.description: Define the version of the Connect protocol

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`. This is used to determine the schema of the data in the `value` field and is the discriminator for the `debug` field.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.

contentType.title: content_type
contentType.description: MIME type of the attachment (e.g., application/pdf).

url.title: url
url.description: URL to download the attachment from.

v1.Attachment.title: Attachment
v1.Attachment.description: Attachment represents a file to be attached to the email.

type.title: type
type.description: DNS record type: CNAME, TXT, MX

nameShort.title: name_short
nameShort.description: Short name for DNS providers that want just the subdomain (e.g., "abc._domainkey")

discoveredValue.title: discovered_value
discoveredValue.description: What we found in DNS (after verification)

v1.DnsRecord.title: DnsRecord
v1.DnsRecord.description: DnsRecord represents a single DNS record to configure.

v1.Domain.title: Domain
v1.Domain.description: Domain represents a sending domain with all its configuration.

v1.DomainRecords.title: DomainRecords
v1.DomainRecords.description: DomainRecords contains all DNS records needed for email.

v1.DomainStatus.title: DomainStatus
v1.DomainStatus.description:
DomainStatus represents the overall status of a domain.
 Use in code: if (domain.status === DomainStatus.READY)

message.title: message
message.description: e.g., "Add 3 DNS records to start sending" or "Ready to send emails!"

nextAction.title: next_action
nextAction.description: What the user should do next: CONFIGURE_DNS, WAIT, NONE

v1.DomainSummary.title: DomainSummary
v1.DomainSummary.description: DomainSummary provides human-readable status for lazy users.

diagnosticCodes.title: diagnostic_codes
diagnosticCodes.description: Diagnostic codes for each bounced recipient.

v1.EmailBouncedEvent.title: EmailBouncedEvent
v1.EmailBouncedEvent.description: EmailBouncedEvent is sent when an email bounces.

v1.EmailComplainedEvent.title: EmailComplainedEvent
v1.EmailComplainedEvent.description: EmailComplainedEvent is sent when a recipient marks the email as spam.

v1.EmailDelayedEvent.title: EmailDelayedEvent
v1.EmailDelayedEvent.description: EmailDelayedEvent is sent when email delivery is delayed.

smtpResponse.title: smtp_response
smtpResponse.description: SMTP response from the recipient's mail server.

v1.EmailDeliveredEvent.title: EmailDeliveredEvent
v1.EmailDeliveredEvent.description: EmailDeliveredEvent is sent when an email is delivered to the recipient's mailbox.

v1.EmailFailedEvent.title: EmailFailedEvent
v1.EmailFailedEvent.description: EmailFailedEvent is sent when email sending fails permanently.

v1.EmailRejectedEvent.title: EmailRejectedEvent
v1.EmailRejectedEvent.description: EmailRejectedEvent is sent when SES rejects the email.

userId.title: user_id
userId.description: User who owns the original email.

inReplyTo.title: in_reply_to
inReplyTo.description: Message-ID of the email being replied to.

parentEmailId.title: parent_email_id
parentEmailId.description: Our email ID of the original email being replied to.

v1.EmailRepliedEvent.title: EmailRepliedEvent
v1.EmailRepliedEvent.description: EmailRepliedEvent is sent when a reply to a sent email is received.

emailId.title: email_id
emailId.description: Our internal email ID for tracking.

metadata.title: metadata
metadata.description: Custom metadata passed with the email.

v1.EmailSentEvent.title: EmailSentEvent
v1.EmailSentEvent.description: EmailSentEvent is sent when an email is accepted for delivery.

v1.EmailStatus.title: EmailStatus
v1.EmailStatus.description: EmailStatus represents the current processing status.

id.title: id
id.description: Unique event ID (Redis stream ID when streaming).

v1.Event.title: Event
v1.Event.description:
Event is the envelope for all events.
 Used for both webhook payloads and streaming responses.

v1.EventType.title: EventType
v1.EventType.description: EventType defines the types of events that can be delivered.

pageSize.title: page_size
pageSize.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 10.

total.title: total
total.description: Total number of domains for pagination

v1.RecordStatus.title: RecordStatus
v1.RecordStatus.description:
RecordStatus represents the status of a single DNS record.
 Use in code: if (record.status === RecordStatus.FOUND)

v1.RecordType.title: RecordType
v1.RecordType.description: RecordType identifies the purpose of a DNS record.

from.title: from
from.description: Sender email address (must be from a verified domain).

to.title: to
to.description: List of primary recipient email addresses.

cc.title: cc
cc.description: List of CC recipient email addresses.

bcc.title: bcc
bcc.description: List of BCC recipient email addresses.

body.title: body
body.description: Plain text content of the email.

scheduledAt.title: scheduled_at
scheduledAt.description:
Optional timestamp to schedule the email for future delivery (UTC).
 If set, the email will be sent at this time instead of immediately.
 Uses UTC timezone - clients should convert local time to UTC before sending.

inReplyTo.title: in_reply_to
inReplyTo.description: Message-ID of the email being replied to (for threading).

references.title: references
references.description:
Full list of message IDs in the thread (for proper threading).
 Should include in_reply_to and all previous message IDs.

async.title: async
async.description:
If true, queue for async processing (we handle retries).
 If false, send synchronously and return message_id immediately.
 Note: Emails with attachments are always processed async.

v1.SendEmailRequest.title: SendEmailRequest
v1.SendEmailRequest.description: SendEmailRequest is the payload for sending an email.

id.title: id
id.description: Unique identifier for tracking this email.

messageId.title: message_id
messageId.description: SES Message-ID (only present if sync send succeeded).

v1.SendEmailResponse.title: SendEmailResponse
v1.SendEmailResponse.description: SendEmailResponse contains the result of a send request.

cursor.title: cursor
cursor.description:
Cursor position to start from (event ID).
 Empty string means start from latest events.
 Use "0" to start from the beginning of the stream.

batchSize.title: batch_size
batchSize.description: Number of events to batch (1-100, default: 10).

v1.StreamEventsRequest.title: StreamEventsRequest
v1.StreamEventsRequest.description: StreamEventsRequest is the request for streaming events.

wasRefreshed.title: was_refreshed
wasRefreshed.description: True if we actually checked (false if rate-limited)

nextRetryAt.title: next_retry_at
nextRetryAt.description: When next check is allowed (if rate-limited)

 Add your domain, configure DNS records, and start sending emails.

tags.name: v1.EmailService
tags.description:
EmailService handles email sending operations.
 This is a stateless, compliance-first API - no email content is stored.
